xna-type.name: PixelBitmapContent Generic
xna-type.summary: Provides methods for maintaining a 2D array of pixel values.
xna-type.syntax: public class PixelBitmapContent<T> : BitmapContent where T : ValueType, IEquatable
xna-type.remarks: Pixel bitmaps are represented as a 2D array of independent pixel values. The pixel type will often be from the Graphics.PackedVector namespace, but can also be System.Single , Vector2 , Vector3 , or Vector4 . A pixel bitmap of Vector4 values is commonly used as an intermediate format for image manipulation operations.
